sourceReasoning.explicitUnknown: unknownCleanup(error) is the unchanged closed descriptor-based classifier. The added flag records explicit cleanup debt from this one original fetch rejection before rethrowing the same object. If the wrapper abort wins the race, the original debt still participates in the same abort/deadline guard.

Aborting the pair queues the original rejection reaction, then the wrapper deadline reaction. The rejection handler updates both local facts before catch, while its derived work rejection can lose the wrapper Promise.race. This is why a second fact is required rather than clearing pending alone.
